title: Section 51 — Powers of Court to enforce execution — CPC 1908

content.heading: Powers of Court to enforce execution
content.text: Subject to such conditions and limitations as may be prescribed, the Court may, on the application of the decree-holder, order execution of the decree by delivery of any property specifically decreed; by attachment and sale or by sale without attachment of any property; by arrest and detention in prison; by appointing a receiver; or in such other manner as the nature of the relief granted may require. Provisos restrict arrest in money decrees unless bad faith or other enacted grounds are recorded.
